modelHelpLive: Requested, applied and effective settings are separate. Saving a choice never edits the Agent; applying does, after preview and confirmation.
noInstallationsHelp: Install with a vetted package-manager recipe, or install it yourself and scan again.

configurationHelpLive: Configuration files, installations and recovery history read from this computer.
